420:t_029:13.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「$$ハイアデス$$ traveled all over the galaxy looking for battles...」

420:t_029:14.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I heard joining $$サイデリアル$$ would let us have more exciting fights. It looks like that's finally happening.」

420:t_029:15.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Guys! Are you ready!?」

420:t_029:18.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「These bastards...! Do they think fighting is a game!?」

420:t_029:19.en:
$$シャア$$
「Getting angry is pointless, $$カミーユ$$. Their minds work differently from ours.」

420:t_029:20.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「The $$欲深な金牛$$... It seems desire is the source of its power.」

420:t_029:22.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Hahahahaha, $$ストラウス$$! So you've taken off your armor!」

420:t_029:23.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I couldn't help it. It got broken.」

420:t_029:25.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I know. I'm not reckless enough to stay where you're fighting.」

420:t_029:27.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「It was worth coming all this way.」

420:t_029:28.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$n... Next time, I'll bring $$西条涼音$$, just as you wished.」

420:t_029:29.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Though I won't guarantee what condition she'll be in.」

420:t_029:33.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You've served me well all this time.」

420:t_029:35.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Here's your reward. I'll unleash the hatred inside you.」

420:t_030:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「What's he going to do!?」

420:t_030:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
「He said he'd unleash his hatred, but...」

420:t_030:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The aura coming from $$ギルター$$...!」

420:t_030:7.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I-I am $$ギルター・ベローネ$$! Anyone who insults me can dieeee!!」

420:t_030:8.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「That's some fine hatred, $$ギルター$$. Keeping you as a pet has paid off.」

420:t_030:9.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You were a mass of inferiority and jealousy. Putting you under $$サルディアス$$ was the right way to raise you.」

420:t_030:10.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$バルビエル$$! Did you amplify your subordinate $$ギルター$$'s hatred and destroy his mind!?」

420:t_030:11.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That bastard...! He did it again!」

420:t_030:12.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I'll leave the rest to you, $$ギルター$$. ...Though you have no future, even if you defeat $c.」

420:t_030:14.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Don't get carried away, $n. Your awakening is still unstable.」

420:t_030:15.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「The slightest trigger will let the backlash kill your mind... Can you endure that?」

420:t_030:17.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I look forward to seeing you again, $c! Next time, I'll invite your beloved Miss $$スズネ$$ too!」

420:t_031:1.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「All right, all right. There's no point chasing a scorpion that's run away.」

420:t_032:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Now let's have some fun together! Let's enjoy the party!!」

420:t_032:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「So fighting is what you crave!?」

420:t_032:2.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Exactly! And I think Darling's the perfect partner, since he can take whatever I dish out.」

420:t_032:4.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Darling is Darling, so what's wrong with calling him Darling?」

420:t_032:5.en:
$$メール$$
「I'm the only one who gets to call Darling 'Darling'!」

420:t_032:6.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「You're stingy! Fine, then! I'll take him from you!」

420:t_032:7.en:
$$シモン$$
「She looks like she's joking, but the pressure she gives off is much greater than when she wore armor!」

420:t_032:8.en:
$$竜馬$$
「So once her armor burst off, her desire went into overdrive too!」

420:t_032:9.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Lady $$エルーナ$$! Ignore a man like him and direct our advance at once!」

420:t_032:10.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「What's the matter, $$ダバラーン$$? Are you jealous?」

420:t_032:11.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「I-I am your faithful right hand, Lady $$エルーナ$$! I-I would never harbor such improper feelings...!」

420:t_032:12.en:
$$赤木$$
(So that devotion of his wasn't loyalty after all...!)

420:t_032:14.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Now, $$ギルター$$! Let's have fun too!」

420:t_032:15.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I'll kill you...! I'll kill you!!」

420:t_032:16.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Oh dear... Once a person ends up like that, they're finished...」

420:t_032:17.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I do have to apologize to $$アウストラリス$$. I guess I can fight for about three minutes.」

420:t_032:19.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Warriors of $$ハイアデス$$! Lady $$エルーナ$$ has given her orders! We'll bury $c in these three minutes!」

420:t_033:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「Try it if you can, $$エルーナルーナ$$!」

420:t_033:1.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Hee hee... Let's have lots of fun, Darling!」

420:t_034:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I-I am $$ギルター・ベローネ$$! I am $$サイデリアル$$'s greatest strategist, a general worthy of being $$アンタレス$$'s deputy commander!」

420:t_034:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「All you ignorant fools, bow to me! $$サルディアス$$, $$バルビエル$$, and $$皇帝アウストラリス$$ too!」

420:t_035:2.en:
$$刹那$$
「Has he come to his senses...!?」

420:t_035:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Has facing death freed him from $$バルビエル$$'s control...?」

420:t_035:4.en:
$$ギルター$$
「N-no...! I don't want to die! I...!」

420:t_036:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Oh dear... If he'd just stayed alive, he could have enjoyed so many more battles...」

420:t_036:1.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I'm kind of out of the mood now. Maybe I'll head home for today.」

420:t_036:3.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Don't be so eager. Next time, let's have an even hotter fight.」
